findings.current: {count, number}ng / {count, number}g / {count, number}p / {count, number}gi
findings.proposed: {count, number} ngày / {count, number} giờ / {count, number} phút / {count, number} giây  (compact fallback if a chip cannot take it: {count, number}d / {count, number}h / {count, number}p / {count, number}s)
findings.reason: Rendered through expiry.in / deadline.with_subject / response.timed_out: «hết hạn sau 45gi», «hết hạn sau 2ng», «Hết thời gian chờ sau 2ng — …» — «ng» and «gi» are not Vietnamese abbreviations anyone reads as days/seconds, and «g» for giờ is non-standard; every other vi surface spells these units out (shipped ui.notifications.time.minutes «{count} phút», .hours «{count} giờ», ui.projects.project_model.value_d «{value} ngày», ui.hub.comments.age.seconds «giây trước») and the fr/es/ru/hi/ur/zh-CN B1 catalogues use real unit symbols or words. Invented abbreviations in a countdown that conveys urgency are a rendered readability defect, not style. Width: +4 cells per duration; the sidecar says compact, so if a chip cannot take the words use the ISO-style d/h/p/s fallback (p for phút is acceptable) — flag for one rendered check.
